rows.note: Use 自發 as the all-purpose choice for an action that comes from the person’s own initiative rather than prompting.

example.english: They made a spontaneous decision to help the neighbour move; nobody asked them to.
example.traditional: 佢哋自發幫鄰居搬屋，冇人叫過佢哋。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zi6 faat3 bong1 leon4 geoi1 bun1 uk1 mou5 jan4 giu3 gwo3 keoi5 dei6

rows.note: Use 自然 when a feeling or action comes out naturally and without being forced or arranged.

example.english: I gave a spontaneous smile; I wasn't pretending.
example.traditional: 我係自然咁笑出嚟，唔係特登扮嘅。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 zi6 jin4 gam3 siu3 ceot1 lai4 m4 hai6 dak6 dang1 baan6 ge3

rows.note: Use 即興 when something is done or said without preparation, especially an improvised speech, performance, or remark.

example.english: The host suddenly asked me to go onstage, so I made a few spontaneous remarks.
example.traditional: 主持突然叫我上台，我即興講咗幾句。
example.jyutping: zyu2 ci4 dat6 jin4 giu3 ngo5 soeng5 toi1 ngo5 zik1 hing3 gong2 zo2 gei2 geoi3
